messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**ATP (Men’s) – Current Top‑Ranked Player**

| Rank | Player | Country |
|------|--------|---------|
| **No 1** | *Carlos Alcaraz* | Spain |

> **Why it matters:**  
> - Alcaraz reclaimed the top spot during the week ending **July 5, 2024**, following his strong performances across hard‑court events and his victory over Novak Djokovic at the Madrid Masters.  
> - His win streak and consistent results against other top‑10 opponents kept him ahead of rivals such as Daniil Medvedev, Jannik Sinner, and Alexander Zverev.  

---

### How Rankings Are Determined

The ATP uses a rolling 52‑week system where each player's best 18 tournament results count toward their total points. Points drop off when tournaments repeat next year, so even small changes—like losing a title or winning a new one—can shift the leaderboard.

For example:

| Tournament | Winner | Points Awarded |
|------------|--------|----------------|
| French Open | Rafael Nadal | 2000 |
| Wimbledon | Novak Djokovic | 2000 |
| U.S. Open | Carlos Alcaraz | 2000 |
| ... | ... | ... |

Alcaraz's recent deep runs in Grand Slams and Masters 1000s gave him enough points to stay atop.

---

#### Quick Check Yourself

If you’d like real‑time confirmation, visit the [official ATP website](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles) or use the “Live” tab under “Ranking History.” These pages update automatically every Monday morning.

---

### Women’s Tennis (WTA)

While your question asked about the overall top rank, here’s the corresponding information for completeness:

| Rank | Player | Country |
|------|--------|---------|
| **No 1** | *Iga Świątek* | Poland |

Świątek has held the WTA No. 1 position continuously since September 2020, thanks largely to her dominant play at Roland Garros and consistent performance throughout the calendar year.

---

#### Bottom Line

As of now, **Carlos Alcaraz leads the ATP rankings** while **Iga Świątek tops the WTA list**. Keep in mind that rankings fluctuate weekly, especially around major tournaments, so always double-check if you’re planning something time‑critical!
